page: Amazon Web Services c7gd.2xlarge is an ARM-based compute-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro System and AWS Neoverse-V1 ARMv8 processors running at 2.6 GHz. The server supplies 8 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core and no simultaneous multithreading. It provides 16.0 GB of total memory, establishing a 1:2 compute-optimized ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Hardware provisioning includes 474 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD instance storage and a 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operating without discrete GPU accelerators.

Benchmark evaluations place the instance within average tiers for general compute tasks, recording a stress-ng multi-core score of 12241.51 and a single-core score of 1532.19. In Clang software compilation tests via Geekbench, the system achieves a score of 11945.0, supported by multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 42.76 GB/sec. Synthetic tests in PassMark show lower relative execution, yielding a composite CPU score of 6060.19 and an encryption score of 1110.82. For network and memory services, Redis operations reach 12.54 million set operations per second, alongside 15.36 GB/sec in static web serving throughput.

The bundled NVMe storage and dedicated core allocation provide predictable I/O access and consistent processing cycles without hyperthreading contention. Because memory is limited to 16.0 GB and LLM processing benchmarks indicate low prompt processing throughput, this instance is ill-fitted for large machine learning models or high-footprint databases. It is functionally targeted at software compilation pipelines, web application serving, continuous integration runners, and caching layers requiring fast local storage.
description: Amazon Web Services c7gd.2xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance based on the 64-bit ARM architecture and AWS Nitro System. It is equipped with 8 dedicated AWS Neoverse-V1 physical cores operating at 2.6 GHz with one thread per core, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory. Storage is provided directly via 474 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD space, and network throughput features a 4 Gbps baseline, with no discrete GPUs available. Benchmark measurements reflect solid mid-tier multi-threaded processing, displaying balanced Clang software compilation scores and static web serving speeds of 15.36 GB/sec, alongside high Redis caching throughput. The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory profile and local fast storage make the server effective for code compilation, CI/CD workloads, caching infrastructure, and containerized microservices.
